context: A mom comforts her young son after a school mistake
purpose: Teach: 犯し/払わ/許す/かわいそう/始末/はずれ/目立っ/見かける

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、やっちゃった…大きなミスを犯しちゃって、先生に怒られた。
lines.en: Mom, I messed up... I made a big mistake and the teacher scolded me.
lines.style: Tearful child voice, sniffling and trembling with shame

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、かわいそうに。何があったの?ゆっくり話してごらん。
lines.en: Oh, you poor thing. What happened? Tell me slowly.
lines.style: Soft maternal warmth, gentle and patient tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 国旗を運ぶ係だったのに、落としちゃって、目立っちゃって、みんなに笑われた。
lines.en: I was the flag carrier but I dropped it, really stood out, and everyone laughed.
lines.style: Embarrassed mumbling, words tumbling out in shame

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そっか…ちょっと注意を払わなかっただけよね。誰だってそういう失敗はあるのよ。
lines.en: I see... you just weren't paying attention for a moment. Anyone makes that kind of slip.
lines.style: Reassuring and understanding, smoothing tone like stroking hair

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でも先生、始末書みたいな反省文を書けって…ぼく、もう学校行きたくない。
lines.en: But the teacher told me to write a reflection like a formal apology... I don't wanna go to school.
lines.style: Whining and desperate, voice cracking near tears

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 大丈夫よ。ママも子供の頃、運動会で旗を落として、すごく目立っちゃったの。
lines.en: It's okay. When Mom was little, I dropped a flag at sports day too and really stood out.
lines.style: Nostalgic and soothing, sharing a secret confession

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ほんと?ママでも?今でもそんな失敗する子、学校で見かける?
lines.en: Really? Even you? Do you still see kids making mistakes like that at school?
lines.style: Surprised curiosity breaking through the tears slightly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、たまに見かけるよ。みんな同じなの。自分のことを許す気持ちが、何よりも大事よ。
lines.en: Yeah, I see them sometimes. Everyone's the same. The feeling of forgiving yourself matters more than anything.
lines.style: Tender finality, warm embrace conveyed through gentle voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…ママのおかげで、ちょっと気持ちが楽になった。明日、学校行ってみる。
lines.en: Yeah... thanks to Mom, I feel a little better. I'll try going to school tomorrow.
lines.style: Quiet relief and small brave smile through lingering sniffles

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: えらいね。町のはずれの公園、帰りに一緒に寄ろうか。アイス買ってあげる。
lines.en: Good boy. Want to stop by the park on the edge of town on the way back? I'll buy you ice cream.
lines.style: Cheerful warmth lifting the mood with a small treat promise
